source.name: Aroma Veil
source.originalDescription: When an ally is under the effect of one of Alcremie's shields or buffs, remove any hindrances that are applied or are currently affecting that ally. This ability will go on cooldown for 10s after removing a hindrance. This ability can also work on Alcremie as well. When Milcery evolves into Alcremie, gain a Sweet Gauge. When the Sweet Gauge is filled at 15 stacks, the cooldown of one charge of Recover and Decorate will be reset. These moves will also be empowered.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Aroma Veil は シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。

source.name: Fluffy Cream Supreme
source.originalDescription: Create a giant cake and stand atop it becoming unstoppable and gaining a shield for 6s. Then throw whipped cream at allies. Allies who receive whipped cream are healed and have their maximum HP buffed for 8s. This move ends early if this move's shield is lost, Alcremie becomes bound, or if the move is manually cancelled. The shield is 60% of Alcremie's max HP Buffs: 40% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 30% Max HP Shield (Applied when the move ends)
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Fluffy Cream Supreme は バインドを付与する、相手を打ち上げる、妨害無効になる、待ち時間を短縮する、HPを回復する、シールドを付与する、最大HPを変化させる。
